messages:
Ethan: Quick ask (12:03) - Acme wants a Hosted API key for a short POC (48h). Needs IP allowlist, scoped to generation only, daily rotation, and audit logs. Can someone run the handoff?
Priya: I got this. Please confirm CIDRs and whether they want embeddings later. We default to 24h TTL for security; can do 48h if needed.
Ethan: CIDR: 198.51.100.128/28. No embeddings for now. 48h OK if sales needs simpler UX.
security-bot: Security policy: POC keys must be scoped, IP-locked, TTL <= 48h, KMS-backed audit logs enabled, and console UI disabled. Enable anomaly alert at >2x baseline.
Priya: Plan: create scoped key `poc_acme_gen`, ttl=172800, ip_allowlist set, model whitelist gpt-4-lite. Set soft token quota 100k/day and throttle to 20rps. Example internal create:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.local/v1/keys \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"customer":"acme","scope":"generation","models":["gpt-4-lite"],"ttl":172800,"ip_allowlist":["198.51.100.128/28"]}'
```
Priya: Response (redacted):
```json
{"key_id":"k_acme_poc_2026_12","secret":"sk_live_xxx","expires_at":2461922000}
```
ops-bot: Provision request accepted. Creating key...
ops-bot: Key created k_acme_poc_2026_12 (expires 2461922000). Secret posted to #secure-handoff. Audit logging (KMS) enabled.
Maya: For rotation, we run a daily rotate at 03:00 UTC. Process: call internal rotate endpoint, validate new key by making a test generate call, then revoke old key immediately. Rotate example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.local/v1/keys/rotate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\n  -d '{"key_id":"k_acme_poc_2026_12","revoke_old":true}'
```
Maya: We'll post the new secret to #secure-handoff and DM the AE. Old secret revoked right after successful rotate.
security-bot: Add: retention for audit logs set to 90d for POC. If Acme requests extended retention, escalate to compliance.
Ethan: Thanks. Sales note: give them a $2k credit for the POC window and offer Dedicated if they need >50rps sustained.
Priya: Posted handoff to #secure-handoff and DM'd AE with README: sample call, allowed models, TTL, rotation cadence, how to request extension. Closing thread after customer confirms successful call.
Ethan: Confirmed by customer 12:24 - they hit generate and returned 200. Closing. :white_check_mark:
